card.line: Mount Moriah is the mountain region where God tested Abraham with his son Isaac, and where Solomon later built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem.

moments.title: God tests Abraham
moments.text: God tells Abraham to take his son Isaac to the land of Moriah and offer him there on a mountain that God will show him. Abraham gets up early and sets out.

moments.title: Solomon builds the temple
moments.text: Solomon begins to build the house of the LORD on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem. This is where the LORD had appeared to David, on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
